clue.text: Nothing received, switching to auto: neither heard?

definitions.text: Nothing received, switching to auto: neither heard?

indicators.note: something received is taken in, so it ends up inside the other letters
switching things around changes their places, so the following words are rearranged

parts.note: the anagram fodder, taken letter by letter
none means not any, nothing at all

explanation.surface: A driver flicks the gearbox to automatic and nobody in the car hears a thing.
explanation.walkthrough: The anagram of 'to auto neither heard' takes NONE in after its first letter. The whole clue is also the definition: something that goes in one ear and out the other is, in effect, not heard.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom describes words that a listener fails to absorb, so nothing is really taken in and they are as good as unheard.

clue.text: Reason she's left me, so there's this

definitions.meaning: first meaning: common sense, practical intelligence

definitions.text: she's left me, so there's this
definitions.meaning: second meaning, read as two words: after a break-up the couple no longer exists

explanation.surface: A jilted lover tries to reason out why the relationship ended.
explanation.walkthrough: Split the answer 2,2: if she has left me, there is NO US. The definition is the first word, an everyday British word for common sense.
explanation.definitionFit: Nous is British informal speech for good sense or shrewdness, close to the faculty of reason.

clue.text: Mark lipogrammatic dictum, possibly, such as for this?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: to take notice of, or a sign

definitions.text: lipogrammatic dictum, possibly, such as for this?
definitions.meaning: second meaning, split 3,1: the rule a writer of a lipogram might set, banning the commonest letter

explanation.surface: A puzzling instruction about a rule for writing without a particular symbol.
explanation.walkthrough: A lipogram is writing that avoids one letter. Read as NOT E, the answer is the rule this very clue obeys: the clue itself contains no letter E.
explanation.definitionFit: To note something is to mark or observe it, and a note is also a written mark.

clue.text: The writer and his team revolutionised style of Roquefort or pecorino?

indicators.note: a revolution turns something right round, so the writer and team words are read backwards

parts.note: a writer refers to himself as me
the writer together with his team are we
ilk means type or kind

explanation.surface: A writer and his team have transformed the way two famous cheeses are made.
explanation.walkthrough: MEWE turned round becomes EWEM, and ILK follows. The question mark covers defining the cheeses by what they are made from.
explanation.definitionFit: Roquefort and pecorino are both cheeses made from the milk of sheep, so each is, in a sense, a product of that milk.

clue.text: Judges seen to signal her upcoming remorse

definitions.text: Judges seen to signal her upcoming
definitions.meaning: first meaning: in the Old Testament the book of Judges is followed by the book named after this woman
second meaning: an archaic word for pity or sorrow

explanation.surface: A court's judges hint that a defendant's contrition is coming.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Judges' is not a bench of magistrates but the Bible book; its successor is the book of Ruth.
explanation.definitionFit: Ruth is an old word for compassion or regret, surviving in ruthless, which means without pity.

clue.text: So many airlifted rations lacking oxygen gas

indicators.note: lifted into the air in a down answer, so the letters run upwards and are read backwards
lacking something means being without it, so that element is taken away

parts.note: rations are supplies of food
O is the chemical symbol for oxygen
neon is a noble gas

explanation.surface: Huge quantities of supplies are flown in by air, though without any oxygen.
explanation.walkthrough: FOOD loses one O to give FOD; NEON is added, and the whole of FODNEON is read upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: 'No end of' is an idiom meaning a great many, so it can replace 'so many' in a sentence such as 'there were so many problems'.

clue.text: Jockey got why folk don't see me bet, I think

indicators.note: to jockey is to manoeuvre and jostle for position, so the following letters are moved about

parts.words: got why folk don't see me bet
parts.note: the anagram fodder, every letter used

explanation.surface: A jockey wonders why punters don't back him at the races.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Jockey' reads as a rider puzzling over gamblers, but it is the verb meaning to manoeuvre.
explanation.definitionFit: Both phrases are hedges a speaker uses to signal belief rather than certainty.

clue.text: See 7
Pass act to comply with fish avoidance
See 1
After which it may be said to stop mother

definitions.meaning: first meaning: at the point after which

definitions.text: it may be said to stop mother
definitions.meaning: second meaning: the word you say to stop someone pouring your drink

explanation.surface: Some phrase that, once uttered, will silence a mother.
explanation.walkthrough: In Britain the person pouring the tea is said to 'be mother'; you tell them to stop by saying 'Say when' and answering with this word.
explanation.definitionFit: The word works as a relative adverb for the moment at or after which something happens.

clue.text: Badly bonked head on screen in guest house accommodation: fixes picture

indicators.note: in places the jumbled letters inside the guest house abbreviation

parts.note: a B and B, bed and breakfast, is a guest house

indicators.note: something done badly is botched or messed up, so the letters come out jumbled

parts.note: the anagram fodder, as printed

indicators.note: the head of a word is its beginning, so only its opening letter is kept

parts.note: the first letter of screen
a room is accommodation
sticks means fixes or attaches

explanation.surface: Someone at a guest house bangs their head on a screen and then repairs a picture on the wall.
explanation.walkthrough: The scrambled letters sit after the first B of 'B and B'. 'Picture' is a film: the 1971 Disney musical starring Angela Lansbury.
explanation.definitionFit: Picture is a standard word for a film, and this is the title of a well-known Disney film.

clue.text: See 12
Rough 25s could constitute refusal

indicators.note: to constitute is to make up from parts, so the letters are assembled into a new order

parts.note: the anagram fodder

explanation.surface: Some harsh language might amount to saying no.
explanation.walkthrough: 25 refers to the answer at 25-down, WORD, so the definition reads 'rough words'.
explanation.definitionFit: An earful is a long angry scolding, so earfuls are harsh words heaped on someone.

clue.text: Like to have a bit of a kip and something to eat

indicators.note: to have something is to hold it, so the one word takes the coin inside it

parts.note: say means for example, as like does in 'a fruit like an apple'
the kip is the currency of Laos, and the at is a hundredth of it

explanation.surface: Someone fancies a short nap and then a snack.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Kip' looks like British slang for a nap, but here it is the Laotian currency, divided into 100 at.
explanation.definitionFit: Satay is a South-East Asian dish of grilled skewered meat with peanut sauce, so it is a thing to eat.

clue.text: Pine front projector?

parts.note: to pine for is to long for
the bow is the front of a ship

explanation.surface: A cinema projector placed at the front of a hall built of pine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Projector' suggests a cinema machine, but the question mark flags something that projects arrows.
explanation.definitionFit: A longbow launches, or projects, arrows, so it is a projector in a punning sense.

clue.text: Happy in drink, with a cigarette on the go

definitions.meaning: first meaning: tipsy, merry from alcohol

definitions.text: with a cigarette on the go
definitions.meaning: second meaning: having just started smoking

explanation.surface: A cheerful drinker in a bar with a cigarette going.
explanation.definitionFit: Lit up is slang for drunk, and also describes someone who has set light to a cigarette.

clue.text: From rear, see whether king faces Islamic chief

parts.note: K is king in chess notation

indicators.note: starting from the rear means reading from back to front

parts.note: la is an archaic exclamation meaning look or see
if can mean whether, as in 'ask if it is true'

explanation.surface: Seen from behind, a monarch is confronting a Muslim leader.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Faces' is a placement word here: the king goes in front. The archaic exclamation for 'see' survives in 'lo and behold' and 'la!'.
explanation.definitionFit: Kalif is a variant spelling of caliph, the title of a Muslim ruler regarded as successor to Muhammad.

clue.text: The speed of the sea bird

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a nautical unit of speed
second meaning: a wading bird of the sandpiper family

explanation.surface: A seabird's flying speed.
explanation.definitionFit: Ships measure speed in nautical miles per hour, and a red knot is a shore-dwelling wader.

clue.text: Eastern county's forgotten by nature

indicators.note: what is forgotten is left out, so one letter is dropped

parts.note: Essex is a county in the east of England
x is the multiplication sign, as in 'two by four'

explanation.surface: A county in the east has been overlooked by the natural world.
explanation.walkthrough: 'By' looks like a preposition but is the X in measurements such as 3 by 4.
explanation.definitionFit: Esse is Latin for 'to be', used in English philosophy for essential being or essence.

clue.text: Venetian city house with a university resident

indicators.note: a resident lives inside a place, so that letter is housed within the others

parts.note: a pad is slang for a home
taken as written
U is the abbreviation for university

explanation.surface: A city in the Veneto with a house containing a student.
explanation.walkthrough: The university sits between the house and the A.
explanation.definitionFit: Padua is a city in the Veneto region of Italy, under Venetian rule for centuries, and home to an ancient university.

clue.text: Suggest theatre job in writing

indicators.note: in puts the job inside the word for writing

parts.note: prose is ordinary written language
an op, an operation, is the job done in an operating theatre

explanation.surface: Proposing a stage role in a written document.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Theatre' looks like the stage; it is the operating theatre, where the job done is an operation.
explanation.definitionFit: To propose is to put forward an idea for consideration, which is what suggesting means.

clue.text: Country people breaking into song

indicators.note: someone breaking into a place gets inside it

parts.note: an aria is a solo song in opera
men are people

explanation.surface: A nation's people suddenly start singing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Breaking into song' is a stock phrase meaning starting to sing, which hides its container role.
explanation.definitionFit: Armenia is a nation in the South Caucasus, a sovereign state.

clue.text: As you are unlimited athletically, adopt pole vault

indicators.note: to adopt is to take in, so the pole letter joins the others
athletic moves are leaps and twists, so the letters move around
without its limits, the phrase loses its first and last letters

parts.note: the phrase without its outer letters
S is south, one of the poles

explanation.surface: A pole vaulter is told to keep going freely and nimbly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pole vault' is a single athletics event on the surface; split, the pole is S and the vault is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: An ossuary is a chamber or vault where the bones of the dead are kept.

clue.text: Four after Jay in Great Gatsby intro maybe continue

indicators.note: in places the letter inside the word for the introduction

parts.note: The Great Gatsby is American, so its introduction would be a prolog in US spelling
counting on four letters from J reaches N

explanation.surface: Four pages of Jay Gatsby's story are read in the novel's opening, then it carries on.
explanation.walkthrough: Jay looks like Gatsby's first name, but it is the letter J; K, L, M, N follow it. 'Maybe' flags the American spelling.
explanation.definitionFit: To prolong something is to extend it in time, making it continue for longer.

clue.text: Who's in position to catch the batsman cutting

definitions.text: Who's in position to catch the batsman
definitions.meaning: first meaning: the fielder beside the wicketkeeper in cricket
second meaning: a twig cut from a plant to grow a new one

explanation.surface: A cricket fielder poised for a catch when the batsman plays a cut shot.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket, slip is a close catching position beside the wicketkeeper. 'Cutting' looks like the cut shot but is the gardening sense.
explanation.definitionFit: A slip is both a fielding position and a piece taken from a plant for propagation.

clue.text: Signal the fourth tier from base

indicators.note: starting at the bottom of a down answer means reading upwards, back to front

parts.note: D is the fourth letter, as in row D of a theatre
a tier is a row of seats

explanation.surface: A signal flag flies from the fourth level up.
explanation.walkthrough: The fourth tier of seats is row D; read from the bottom it gives the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To give the word is to give a signal or command, as in 'wait for my word'.

clue.text: POW's last unpropitious deed

indicators.note: the last of a word is its final letter, the only one kept

parts.note: the final letter of POW
ill can mean unfavourable, as in an ill omen

explanation.surface: A prisoner of war's final act was an unlucky one.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Last ... deed' suggests a last will and testament, which is the answer; the clue reads almost as its own definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A will is a legal document disposing of property after death, a kind of formal instrument or deed.

clue.text: On old line I set up close to Cairo, look around for one construction tool

parts.words: On old line I set up close to Cairo,
parts.note: surface padding that also offers alternative routes: the on side in cricket plus old, or a word for set read upwards plus Cairo's last letter

indicators.note: going around something encloses it

parts.note: lo is an old word meaning look or behold
e.g. means for example, for one

explanation.surface: A builder's instructions about lines and Cairo, then a toolkit.
explanation.walkthrough: Elgar crams in several routes to the same answer, so the opening words can be read as extra wordplay or ignored. In cricket the leg side is also called the on side.
explanation.definitionFit: Lego is a construction toy of interlocking bricks, a building kit that works as a tool for making models.

clue.text: Reinforcing offbeat old logo ban, have fancy poster for Camra founder

indicators.note: reinforcing something means bolstering it from within, so further pieces go into it
offbeat means unconventional or out of order, so the letters are scrambled

parts.note: the anagram fodder
to own is to have
to fancy is to like
CAMRA is the Campaign for Real Ale, so its poster is an advert for beer

explanation.surface: A beer campaign's founder designs a fancy poster after an old logo was banned.
explanation.walkthrough: CAMRA is the Campaign for Real Ale, the British beer lobby. 'Camra founder' reads as its creator, but founder is a verb meaning to fail.
explanation.definitionFit: To founder is to fail completely, and something that goes down like a lead balloon is an utter flop.

clue.text: Who brings Victory near landing-stage in sound

indicators.note: in sound means as heard, so the words are judged by pronunciation

parts.note: nigh is an old word for near
a quay is a landing-stage, said like key

explanation.surface: A boat bearing a victorious crew draws close to its jetty.
explanation.walkthrough: Nigh plus quay, said aloud, gives the Greek goddess's name, NY-kee.
explanation.definitionFit: Nike is the winged Greek goddess personifying victory, so she is the one who brings it.
